messages:
Mara: FYI release CI is blocked by a regen diff from typegen; sample-app TS build fails on main after the last template tweak.
Sam: which package/regeneration?
Mara: sdk-js typegen — regen reordered client ctor params so `retryOptions` now appears before `auth`. Lots of internal callsites assume the other order.
Kiran: that sounds like a breaking change. Did the changelog get updated?
Mara: changelog-gen flagged no entry, CI policy treats unexpected API surface diffs as publish-blocking. publish job failed.
dx-bot: publish/job/1254 failed — reason: regen-diff-check FAILED (see CI artifacts)
Sam: can you paste the diff?
Mara: `git --no-pager diff packages/sdk-js/src/clients/*.ts` snippet:
```diff
- constructor(baseUrl: string, auth: Auth, retryOptions?: RetryOpts) {
+ constructor(baseUrl: string, retryOptions?: RetryOpts, auth: Auth) {
```
Jen: oh yikes. That will break positional usage and some generated overloads.
Kiran: two ways: revert the template tweak (fast), or treat as semver-major and add a changelog entry (slower but honest).
Mara: revert would unblock the release immediately. But the original change supposedly fixed builder ergonomics for internal call patterns.
Sam: can we add a postgen normalization step that enforces canonical param order so template changes don't surface unexpectedly?
Jen: I can try a postgen script — patching AST to reorder constructor params back to canonical shape. Will open PR.
publish-bot: comment: rollback recommended if fix will take >1h
Mara: sample-app E2E error from CI: `TS2345: Argument of type 'Auth' is not assignable to parameter of type 'RetryOpts'` at usage sites.
Sam: running locally: `yarn regen && yarn build` — reproduces. stack:
```
ERROR in src/example.ts(42,12): error TS2345: Argument of type 'Auth' is not assignable to parameter of type 'RetryOpts'.
```
Kiran: we should also add a test that verifies generated ctor param order (golden file) so regen diffs like this fail fast in PRs instead of release CI.
Jen: PR opened: https://gh.redwood/inference/pulls/842 - branch `dx/fix-postgen-param-order`. Includes postgen script + unit test to assert constructor param order.
Mara: nice. can you also add a temporary CI step to run `node scripts/postgen-validate.js` during release workflow so this doesn't slip?
Jen: will add. pushing patched script now.
Sam: locally applied Jen's postgen — builds pass. Running full test matrix now.
dx-bot: ci/build/678 re-run started by Jen
Kiran: if CI passes we'll merge and re-run publish. If not, revert the template commit and ship revert to avoid delaying customer fixes.
Jen: CI green on node, TS, and regen-checks. I added the test in `packages/typegen/tests/constructor-order.spec.ts`.
Mara: great — thanks. Please include a short changelog note in the PR describing regression test and postgen guard. We probably don't need semver-major because this reorders back to canonical API.
Sam: also filing a follow-up issue to add a small harness that runs regen in PR CI against golden SDK consumers (sample-app) to catch runtime TypeScript breakages.
Mara: created issue #2194 for that.
publish-bot: publish/job/1254 re-run queued
Jen: merging `dx/fix-postgen-param-order` now.
Kiran: merging since tests are green.
Mara: merging and pinning this release — will watch the publish run. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
publish-bot: publish/job/1254 succeeded — package publish unblocked
Mara: closing thread — follow-up issue is prioritized in the backlog.
